project.name: @kehto/cli
project.summary: The `kehto` command-line tool. Today it has one command, `kehto paja`, which hands everything to the Paja local workshop for building and trying out napplets (sandboxed iframe apps).

nodes.label: Command picker
nodes.summary: Reads the first word typed after `kehto`, shows help, passes `paja` on to the Paja workshop, and rejects anything else.

nodes.label: Tests
nodes.summary: Automatic checks for help text, unknown commands and passing `paja` through.

nodes.label: Build settings
nodes.summary: How the command is bundled for publishing.

nodes.label: Paja workshop
nodes.summary: Kehto's local workshop for running a napplet in a test shell; it does all the real work behind `kehto paja`.

files.name: kehto command tests
files.d: Checks help text, forwarding to Paja without starting it, unknown commands and how the tool spots being run directly.

files.name: kehto command
files.d: Shows help, passes `kehto paja` and its options to the Paja workshop, and rejects any other command with an error.

steps.note: The person types `kehto paja --target-url ...`; the router sees the `paja` command.
The remaining options are handed to the Paja workshop, which starts it and returns the exit code.
